prerequisites: General knowledge of physics, chemistry, and mathematics.

learning_outcomes.text: It is expected that with this course the student acquires knowledge and skills on the fundamentals of Materials Science.
Acquire the fundamental concepts of bonding, structure and microstructure of different types of materials.
Understand the relationship between microstructure, synthesis or processing and the properties of materials.
Know the physical and mechanical properties of different materials, being able to differentiate materials through their properties.
Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for their concretization and clear and succinct exposition.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for the search for sustainable engineering solutions.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of material science, technology, and chemistry. Understand the relationship between microstructure, synthesis or processing, and the properties of materials.

syllabus_topics: Structure and properties of metallic materials.
Structure and properties of ceramic materials.
Structure and properties of polymeric materials.
Structure and properties of composite materials.
teaching_methods: Theoretical classes: lecture will be used to present the theoretical concepts of the course.
Practical classes: formulation, analysis, problem or exercise solving, related to the course topics.
Seminars: in-depth work on a topic. Expansion of content from lectures.
assessment_rules: For the first call, the grade obtained in each part of the course must be at least 4 out of 10 points, and the minimum total grade to pass must be 5 points. For the second call, the grade obtained in the two parts of the exam must be at least 4 out of 10 points, and the minimum total grade to pass must be 5 points. In-class assignments from the first call are carried over for the second call.
